description: Kalshi (US regulated prediction exchange) open events and their markets: event title, category, series, and per market the question, yes/no bid and ask, last price (= implied probability), 24h and total volume, open interest, close time and rules. Filter by series ticker (e.g. KXFED, KXBTC) or category text. From Kalshi's official public market-data API via a proxy; prices in USD per $1 contract. Related tools on this server, for a different need: finance_pendle_finance_markets_v2 when you need Pendle Finance active yield markets on Ethereum: name. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

category.description: Optional category filter (case-insensitive substring), e.g. Economics, Politics, Sports, Crypto

series.description: Optional Kalshi series ticker, e.g. KXFED, KXBTCD, KXELONMARS
